name: bacitracin zinc + neomycin + polymyxin b + pramoxine
purpose: Active ingredients (in each gram) Purpose Bacitracin zinc 500 units First aid antibiotic Neomycin sulfate 3.5 mg First aid antibiotic Polymyxin B sulfate 10,000 units First aid antibiotic Pramoxine HCl 10 mg External analgesic
uses: Uses first aid to help prevent infection and for the temporary relief of pain in minor: cuts scrapes burns
otcwarn: Do not use if you are allergic to any of the ingredients in the eyes over large areas of the body Ask a doctor before use if you have deep or puncture wounds animal bites serious burns Stop use and ask a doctor if you need to use longer than 1 week condition persists or gets worse symptoms persist for more than 1 week, or clear up and occur again within a few days rash or other allergic reaction develops
